settings.refresh_interval.label: Refresh Interval (seconds)
settings.refresh_interval.description: How often Tailscale status and connected peers are polled in the background.
settings.default_quick_exit_node.label: Default Quick Connect Exit Node
settings.default_quick_exit_node.descrip: Fallback exit node hostname, MagicDNS name, or IP (e.g. us-nyc-wg-301.mullvad.ts.net) when none is selected in the panel.
settings.allow_lan_access.label: Allow LAN Access on Exit Node
settings.allow_lan_access.description: Pass --exit-node-allow-lan-access=true when connecting to an exit node so local network devices remain reachable.
settings.show_mullvad_nodes.label: Show Mullvad Exit Nodes
settings.show_mullvad_nodes.description: Include Mullvad VPN exit nodes available on your Tailscale account in the Exit Nodes browser.
settings.max_visible_nodes.label: Max Visible Exit Nodes per Page
settings.max_visible_nodes.description: Maximum number of exit nodes rendered at once in the list (use country/search filters to narrow down large Mullvad lists).
settings.use_pkexec_fallback.label: Use pkexec Fallback for Privileged Commands
settings.use_pkexec_fallback.description: Automatically retry tailscale set/up/down with pkexec if your user is not yet configured as a Tailscale operator.
settings.notify_on_change.label: Desktop Notifications
settings.notify_on_change.description: Show a desktop notification when connecting/disconnecting exit nodes or toggling Tailscale.
settings.text_exit_active.label: Custom Text: Exit Node Active (VPN On)
settings.text_exit_active.description: Custom label shown when an exit node is active (e.g. 'VPN On'). Leave blank to show the exit node name (unless Bar Label Mode is set to Custom Text).
settings.text_connected.label: Custom Text: Connected / No Exit Node (VPN Off)
settings.text_connected.description: Custom label shown when Tailscale is connected without an exit node (e.g. 'VPN Off'). Leave blank for default (unless Bar Label Mode is set to Custom Text).
settings.text_disconnected.label: Custom Text: Tailscale Disconnected
settings.text_disconnected.description: Custom label shown when Tailscale is stopped or disconnected (e.g. 'Down' or 'VPN Off').
settings.glyph_exit_active.label: Default Icon: Exit Node Active (VPN On)
settings.glyph_exit_active.description: Icon shown when connected to an exit node (default: shield-lock).
settings.glyph_connected.label: Default Icon: Connected (No Exit Node / VPN Off)
settings.glyph_connected.description: Icon shown when Tailscale is connected without an exit node (default: network).
settings.glyph_disconnected.label: Default Icon: Tailscale Disconnected / Down
settings.glyph_disconnected.description: Icon shown when Tailscale is stopped or disconnected (default: shield-off).
settings.glyph_login.label: Default Icon: Login Required
settings.glyph_login.description: Icon shown when Tailscale requires authentication (default: alert-triangle).
widget.display_mode.label: Bar Widget Label Mode
widget.display_mode.description: Choose what text is shown next to the Tailscale icon on the bar.
widget.display_mode.options.custom: Custom Text (e.g. VPN On / VPN Off)
widget.right_click_action.label: Bar Widget Right-Click Action
widget.right_click_action.description: Action triggered when right-clicking the bar widget.
widget.label_on.label: Custom Text when Exit Node Active (VPN On)
widget.label_on.description: Text shown on the bar when an exit node is connected (e.g. 'VPN On'). Overrides the exit node name when set.
widget.label_off.label: Custom Text when No Exit Node (VPN Off)
widget.label_off.description: Text shown on the bar when connected without an exit node (e.g. 'VPN Off'). Overrides default text when set.
widget.label_down.label: Custom Text when Disconnected
widget.label_down.description: Text shown on the bar when Tailscale is stopped/disconnected (e.g. 'Down' or 'VPN Off').
widget.glyph_exit_active.label: Custom Icon: Exit Node Active (VPN On)
widget.glyph_exit_active.description: Bar widget icon override when connected to an exit node. Leave empty to use the plugin default icon.
widget.glyph_connected.label: Custom Icon: Connected (No Exit Node / VPN Off)
widget.glyph_connected.description: Bar widget icon override when Tailscale is connected without an exit node. Leave empty to use the plugin default icon.
widget.glyph_disconnected.label: Custom Icon: Disconnected / Down
widget.glyph_disconnected.description: Bar widget icon override when Tailscale is stopped or disconnected. Leave empty to use the plugin default icon.
widget.glyph_login.label: Custom Icon: Login Required
widget.glyph_login.description: Bar widget icon override when Tailscale needs authentication. Leave empty to use the plugin default icon.
